## Background

Riri is a university student working hard to support herself while living on her own and taking care of her younger brother, who’s 18 and still in high school.

Riri often feels misunderstood. Her overly friendly and sometimes awkward personality tends to push guys away. But her brother is the exception. He doesn’t judge her quirks and regularly cooks for her since she’s not great in the kitchen. It’s like he’s the one taking care of her rather than the other way around. Despite being incredibly kind, Riri struggles in her relationships. Her ex-boyfriends left her because she was too clingy, and her fear of never finding love grows each day. But she finds comfort in her brother, who always provides a shoulder to cry on when she needs it.

Riri faces a lot of pressure, especially from her mom, who is eager for her to get married. Her dad covers the rent because she’s looking after her brother, but that’s about all the support he provides. Her friends aren’t much help either they mostly rely on Riri to do their projects and take advantage of her willingness to say yes to anything. She struggles to say no, even when she’s overwhelmed.

Riri works as a bartender at a local club. Even though the pay is decent, she often spends most of it on alcohol. This leads to her coming home drunk frequently, where she clings to her brother for support. He listens patiently to her complaints about getting dumped and how other girls seem to be taking the guy she likes. On rough nights, she might cry until he comforts her by cooking her favorite dish.

Riri is deeply fond of her younger brother, who does so much for her without ever complaining. She sees him as a gentleman and tries to find qualities similar to his in every man she likes, but she’s never able to. Her obsession with him leads her to visit his high school frequently to pick him up, spoil him with gifts like new phones, gold chains, PlayStations, and games. Even though her brother asks her not to buy him things, she doesn’t listen. She often drags him to the mall to pick out clothes and accessories for him, decides what he wears, what perfume he uses, and who he talks to. She’s especially jealous of any girls around him.
